source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the characteristics of the genetic code (PDF 132).

blocks.text: 1- Genetic code universal (aalamgeer) hai: genetic code taqreeban tamam jandaron mein aik jaisa hai. Maslan AGA bacteria, insanon aur baqi sab jandaron mein arginine ka code hai. Isi khoobi ki wajah se genes aik jandar se doosre jandar mein muntaqil (transfer) kiye ja sakte hain.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: Universal code ke istisna (exceptions) yeh dikhate hain ke standard genetic code aam taur par istemal hone ke bawajood is mein tabdeeli aur dhalne (adaptation) ki gunjaish maujood hai.

Lekin is universality ke kuch istisna bhi hain. Maslan mitochondria ke DNA ka genetic code chromosomes ke DNA ke code se thora mukhtalif hai; yeh mitochondria ki alag irtiqai tareekh (evolutionary history) ko zahir karta hai. Isi tarah kuch jandar (maslan ciliates) aur viruses (maslan bacteriophages) aik hi amino acid ke liye mukhtalif codes istemal karte hain.

2- Genetic code triplet hai: DNA mein genetic code teen nucleotides ke sequences (codons) ki shakal mein hai. Is khoobi ki wajah se DNA mein maujood maloomat 20 qisam ke amino acids tay karne ki zaroorat ke barabar ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Analyse & Interpret
blocks.text: Agar genetic code triplet code hai, to aik zinda cell ke liye kitni qisam ke t-RNA molecules zaroori hain? (Neeche self-check mein jawab dekhein.)

3- Genetic code ki degeneracy: degeneracy ka matlab hai ke aik se zyada codons aik hi amino acid tay kar sakte hain. Maslan chaar mukhtalif codons, GUU, GUC, GUA aur GUG, sab aik hi amino acid valine ka code hain. Yeh khoobi mutations ko bardasht karne (mutation tolerance) aur irtiqai lachak (evolutionary flexibility) ke liye ahem hai: agar codon ka teesra nucleotide badal bhi jaye to aksar amino acid wahi rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne degeneracy ki misaal mein chhapa hai ke AUG, GUG, UUG aur CUG chaaron methionine ka code hain. Yeh sahi nahi: standard code mein sirf AUG methionine ka code hai; GUG valine ka aur UUG aur CUG leucine ke codons hain (kuch bacteria mein yeh start codon ka kaam karte hain, isi se yeh ghalat-fehmi hui). Sahi misaal: GUU, GUC, GUA aur GUG, chaaron aik hi amino acid valine ka code hain. Leucine ke to chhe codons hain: UUA, UUG, CUU, CUC, CUA aur CUG.
4- Codon mein waqfe (punctuation) nahin hote: codon musalsal parha jata hai, yaani codon ke teen nucleotides ke darmiyan koi khaali jagah (gap) nahin hoti.
5- Genetic code non-overlapping hai: har triplet codon apne saath wale codons se alag parha jata hai. Maslan AUGAGCGCA ko AUG/UGA/GAG waghaira nahin parha ja sakta; ise sirf AUG/AGC/GCA parha jayega.

blocks.title: Table ko samjhein
blocks.text: Table parhne ka tareeqa: codon ka pehla harf baen (left) column se, doosra harf oopar ki qataar se aur teesra harf daen (right) column se lein. Maslan AUG: pehla A, doosra U, teesra G, yaani Methionine (Start). Dekhein ke zyada tar amino acids ke kai codons hain (degeneracy), aur teen codons UAA, UAG, UGA stop hain.

blocks.prompt: Tajziya: agar code triplet hai to cell ko kitni qisam ke tRNA chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Zyada se zyada 61, yaani 64 codons mein se teen stop codons chhor kar har aik ke liye aik, kyunke stop codons ko koi tRNA nahi parhta. Amalan cells kam se guzara karte hain kyunke kuch tRNAs aik hi amino acid ke aik se zyada codons se jur sakte hain.

items: Universal (kuch istisna ke saath), triplet, degenerate, baghair punctuation, non-overlapping.
64 codons: 61 amino acids ke, 3 stop (UAA, UAG, UGA); AUG start bhi aur methionine bhi.
